I found nothing real for toddler underwater basket weaving in Halton Hills this fall. I searched for basket weaving classes in Halton Hills. Every result was outside the area, and all were adult or workshop classes, with no toddler or underwater class anywhere. I also read the Halton Hills swim page and its library and gallery art listings. None of them offers a toddler basket-weaving or combined swim-and-craft class.

I left out the nearest real programs because they answer a different question. If a swim or art alternative is wanted, these came off the operators' own pages:
- **Parent & Tot 1/2/3 swimming lessons, Town of Halton Hills.** The town's page lists 
Parent and Tot 1: 4 to 12 months, Parent and Tot 2: 12 to 24 months, Parent and Tot 3: 2 to 3 years old
. The Acton fall schedule runs 
Saturday October 3 to Thursday December 3, 2026
, with 
Parent & Tot to Swimmer 3: $86.22 for 9 lessons (30 minute lesson)
. 
Halton Hills taxpayers can register for Fall Recreation Programs beginning Tuesday, September 1 at 7 a.m.
 That date has already passed, so I could not tell whether spots are still open.
- **Art for toddlers.** The library and Helson Gallery listings I found are for older kids, such as 
Mini-Makers, for kids in Grades 1 to 3
. The only all-ages item was a one-off Storytime in the Helson Gallery on October 3.
